description:
Fix reviewed race in BridgeSupervisor by using the existing per-runtime lock for stop and start; retain private unlocked rollback helper within startup. Local-only Action assessment: lifecycle internals owned by BridgeSupervisor, existing Bridge/CommunicationBridge consumers retain tuple contracts and adapter ownership; not suitable as agent/workflow Actions. Deterministic concurrent teardown/start regression plus restart/rollback controls. Preserve provider opts, RAM-only session semantics, runtime table shape. Reject changes requiring weakened assertions or unrelated ownership redesign.

## PR #847 remediation scope (zaq-e5z)

Reused prerequisite for zaq-e5z; blocks zaq-e5z.6. Preserve this issue's narrow existing per-runtime start/stop serialization and unlocked rollback requirements. This repair alone is not sufficient for cleanup safety: zaq-e5z.6 extends the exclusion lifetime through adapter cleanup, Engine disable persistence and runtime stop and must fence stale starts. Do not close that downstream issue just because individual start/stop calls are serialized.
Read docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/channels.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Tests before implementation: deterministic stop/start overlap, startup rollback does not reacquire its own lock, unrelated runtime unaffected, failure and owner termination release behavior. Mock only external transport and keep supervisor/registry/ETS ownership real. Update BridgeSupervisor module docs and issue evidence. Action reuse remains local-only extension of the existing runtime ownership primitive; no new agent/workflow Action. No commits/publication authorized by this plan.

comments.text: User requested reverting this fix attempt. Removed the added regression test; no production changes were made. Fix remains unimplemented.

Reparented from zaq-0l7 to zaq-e5z for the agreed PR #847 remediation. Existing ID, status, history and dependency edges retained. This prevents Beadwork external-blocker rollup from hiding otherwise ready implementation roots; no implementation or gate approval is implied.

Implemented shared node-local per-runtime start/stop lock; teardown body private, startup rollback helpers stay unlocked. New barrier regression first reproduced stop returning not_running during child init; green after lock reuse. All 40 supervisor tests pass, including existing startup rollback and lifecycle cases. mix q passes. Broader affected ZAQ suite: 195 tests + 5 properties, 0 failures. This closes only start/stop serialization, not full cleanup/disable-persistence exclusion in zaq-e5z.6. No commits/publication.
